threats.title: DDoS
threats.description:
Ein DDoS Angriff kann den Login-Dienst überlasten und somit für Anwender unerreichbar machen. 

CAPEC-125: Flooding: An adversary consumes the resources of a target by rapidly engaging in a large number of interactions with the target.

ATT&CK: TA0038 - Network Effects: The adversary is trying to intercept or manipulate network traffic to or from a device.

D: 8 / R: 10 / E: 8 / A: 10 / DREA: 36
threats.mitigation:
Firewall, Load-Balancer oder CDN einsetzen, um direkten Datenverkehr auf Login-Server zu begrenzen.

DEFEND: D3-ITF - Inbound Traffic Filtering
ASVS: CWE 770 (8.1.4): Verify the application can detect and alert on abnormal numbers of requests, such as by IP, user, total per hour or day, or whatever makes sense for the application.

D: 4 / R: 10 / E: 4 / A: 10 / Neuer DREA: 28

threats.title: Session Spoofing
threats.description:
Nach erfolgreiche Auth.  Session ist für ein Jahr gültig. Attacker stiehlt die authentifizierte Sitzung von User.

CAPEC-60: Reusing Session IDs (aka Seesion replay): This attack targets the reuse of valid session ID to spoof the target system in order to gain privileges. The attacker tries to reuse a stolen session ID used previously during a transaction to perform spoofing and session hijacking. Another name for this type of attack is Session Replay.

ATT&CK: T1563 Remote Service Session Hijacking - Adversaries may take control of preexisting sessions with remote services to move laterally in an environment. When a user logs into a service, a session will be established that will allow them to maintain a continuous interaction with that service. 

D:7/R:7/E:5/A:3/DREA:22
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

threats.title: Unverslüsselte Kofigurations Datei auslesen
threats.description:
Angreifer kann wichtige Information aus der Konfigurationsdatei, die nicht unverschlüsselt ist, auslesen.

CAPEC-37: Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data - An attacker examines a target system to find sensitive data that has been embedded within it. This information can reveal confidential contents, such as account numbers or individual keys/credentials that can be used as an intermediate step in a larger attack.

ATT&CK:  T1005 Data from Local System - Adversaries may search local system sources, such as file systems, configuration files, local databases, virtual machine files, or process memory, to find files of interest and sensitive data prior to Exfiltration.
  
D:7/R:8/E:8/A:5/DREA: 28
threats.mitigation:
Sichere Speicherung von Sensible Information (Konfigurationsdatei), Zugriff nur für bestimmte Accounts (Admin). Konfigurationsdatei verschlüsseln und  Backup in anderer Speicherort auch sicher speichern, das ermöglicht Hash von beiden Dateien vergleichen und schauen, ob eine unbefugte Modifikation geführt wurde. 

Mitre D3FEND Matrix D3-FE: File Encryption - Encrypting a file using a cryptographic key.
Mitre D3FEND Matrix D3-FIM File Integrity Monitoring - Detecting any suspicious changes to files in a computer system.

D:5/R:2/E:2/A:3 (Backup wurde nicht gelesen, geändert)/DREA:12

threats.title: Login Funktion Injektion
threats.description:
Durch Injektion und wegen fehlender Eingabe-Bestätigung in der Login Funktion, Angreifer versucht bösartige Code auszuführen um seine Berechtigungen zu steigern. 

CAPEC-234: Hijacking a privileged process - An adversary gains control of a process that is assigned elevated privileges in order to execute arbitrary code with those privileges.

ATT&CK: T1548 Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism - Adversaries may circumvent mechanisms designed to control elevate privileges to gain higher-level permissions. An adversary can perform several methods to take advantage of built-in control mechanisms in order to escalate privileges on a system

D:9/R:10/E:8/A:10/DREA:37
threats.mitigation: Defences include providing enforcement of behavioral workflow and anti-automation

threats.title: Ressource exhaustion
threats.description:
Durch MITM Angriff, werden die Anfragen geändert mit versteckte Code für hohe Ressource Auslastung .

CAPEC-230: Serialized Data with Nested Payloads - Applications often need to transform data in and out of a data format (e.g., XML and YAML) by using a parser. By nesting these structures, causing the data to be repeatedly substituted, an adversary can cause the parser to consume more resources while processing, causing excessive memory consumption and CPU utilization.

ATT&CK:  T1565.002 Transmited Data Manipulation - By manipulating transmitted data, adversaries may attempt to affect a business process, organizational understanding, and decision making.

D:8/R:7/E:5/A:8/DREA: 28
threats.mitigation:
TLS 1.3 und sichere Cipher Suites sind Pflicht. Payload Validation: Größe der Anfrage beschränken und während Deserializierung, Schemas die hoch wahrscheinlich zu Scripts gehören, nicht erlauben 

ASVS 1.5.2 Safe Deserialization:  Verify that deserialization of untrusted data enforces safe input handling, such as using an allowlist of object types or restricting client‑defined object types, to prevent deserialization attacks.

D:8/R:3/E:2/A8/DREA: 21

threats.title: Spoofing von Kundendaten
threats.description:
Angreifer kann sich als "legitimer" Kunde ausgeben, um an kritische Daten / Dienste zu gelangen zu denen er eigentlich keinen Zugriff haben dürfte (Social Engineering beim Kundendienst).

CAPEC ID: 148: Content Spoofing: An adversary modifies content to make it contain something other than what the original content producer intended while keeping the apparent source of the content unchanged.
Att&ck: T1557 (Adversary-in-the-Middle)

D: 9 / R: 8 / E: 5 / A: 4 / DREA: 26
threats.mitigation:
Personal schulen, Kritische Kundendaten als solche für Mitarbeiter in der Support-Software markieren, um Irrtümer zu vermeiden. 

Defend Matrix: D3-NTCD: Network Traffic Community Deviation
ASVS: 1.8.1 : Verify that all sensitive data is identified and classified into protection levels.

D: 4 / R: 4 / E: 2 / A: 4 / Neuer DREA: 14

threats.title: SQL Injection in Database
threats.description:
Angreifer versuch bösartige Code in der DB hinzufügen. 

CAPEC-66: SQL Injection - An attacker crafts input strings so that when the target software constructs SQL statements based on the input, the resulting SQL statement performs actions other than those the application intended.

ATT&CK: T105 Process Injection - Adversaries may inject code into processes in order to evade process-based defenses as well as possibly elevate privileges.

D: 9 R: 10 E: 8 A: 10
threats.mitigation:
Eingaben immer als unsicher behandeln. Vor der Nutzung, User-Input validieren und bereinigen (scaping, prepared statements, white lists).

MASVS-CODE: Code Quality: By treating this data as untrusted, developers can prevent classical injection attacks, such as SQL injection, XSS, or insecure deserialization

D:9/R:3/E:2/A:10/DREA: 24

threats.title: Manipulation von API Message/Request
threats.description:
Angreifer versuch durch Man in the Middle Attack das Inhalt von API Schnittstelle zu ändern (Telefonnummer oder Nachricht an der Kunde).  Kunde bekommt eine gefälschte Nachricht oder gar keine.

CAPEC-384: Application API Message Manipulation via Man-in-the-Middle - An attacker manipulates either egress or ingress data from a client within an application framework in order to change the content of messages. 

ATT&CK: T1557 Adversary in the Middle - Adversaries may attempt to position themselves between two or more networked devices using an adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) technique to support follow-on behaviors such as Network Sniffing, Transmitted Data Manipulation, or replay attacks

D:10/R:8/E:5 (Angefordert sind Angriffsmechanismen )/A:5/ DREA: 28
threats.mitigation:
Reverse Proxy um die Ausgang und Eingang von Anfragen zu steuern und analysieren. Sichere verschlüsselte Kommunikationskanäle wie TLS 1.3 und HTTPS benutzen 

Mitre D3FEND Matrix D3-NTSA: Network Traffic Signature Analysis - Network signature analysis relies on predefined patterns, or signatures, to identify malicious network activity. These signatures typically match against specific byte sequences, packet header information, or protocol anomalies indicative of known threats.

D:10/R:4/E:2/A:5/DREA: 21

threats.title: Log-Dateien
threats.description:
Angreifer löscht, einfügt oder ändern die Information in den Log-Datei, bevor das Wöchentliche Report.

CAPEC-268: Audit Log Manipulation - The attacker injects, manipulates, deletes, or forges malicious log entries into the log file, in an attempt to mislead an audit of the log file or cover tracks of an attack. 

ATT&CK : T154 - Adversaries may also target centralized logging infrastructure such as SIEMs. Logs may also be bulk exported and sent to adversary-controlled infrastructure for offline analysis.
 
D:8/R:8/E:5/A:6(Monitoring auf 2 Funktionen)/DREA: 27
threats.mitigation:
Sicherstellen, dass Eingaben angepasst wurden, unbefugte Zugriff an der Log-Datei ist verboten (nur berechtige Users) und direkte Pipelines mit verschlüsselte Kommunikationskanäle an andere Speicherort (Backup).

ASVS 16.4.1  Verify that all logging components appropriately encode data to prevent log injection.

ASVS 16.4.1 Verify that logs are protected from unauthorized access and cannot be modified.

D:8/R:3/E:3/A:6/DREA:20
